_: Copy-pasteable GG Coder configs for @buzz/mcp. Multiple variants live under top-level keys. Each variant is a complete mcpServers object — copy the inner mcpServers block into your real ~/.gg/mcp.json alongside any existing entries.

trackA_local_pinned_path._: Track A — local pinned path. Recommended for development; lets you rebuild & restart in one cycle.

trackB_npx._: Track B — npx. Recommended for production / shared machines. npx caches the tarball and updates on every CLI pass.

trackB_npx_raw_env._: Track B variant — when the MCP client doesn't expand ${env:...} (plain Claude Code / older ggcoder builds). Use ${VAR} raw per spec §7 line 260.

multi_relay_read_only._: Multi-relay config (Phase 3). The relay list is a JSON array string. Default mode is `mutate-with-confirm` (Phase 1) — set `BUZZ_MCP_MODE=read-only` for the read-only installation that the plan recommends for new operators.

multi_relay_full_mutate._: Multi-relay config with full mutate (writes fan out across all configured relays). For operators who have opted out of the Phase 1 default.
